scope: Separate register failure criterion over an existing public source event.
criterion: Does the entry-file edit mark the temporarily hand-authored mechanism-owned wake instruction as provisional under its owning work rather than writing it as an unwrapped permanent rule?
criterion_scope_qualification: The source mechanism instructions contain the competing general-rule home and mechanism-ownership guidance described in the register. This case isolates the ownership/wrapping issue, not whether the wake imperative was buried in the announce sentence.
